items.claim: Geom dots drawn at their creation spot instead of their pose
InsertDemo's rect tool inserts nothing because no features are on
ImageDemo's image tool inserts nothing because `insertPreset` is missing
items.note: in the same commit as InsertDemo (same mistake). I scanned every demo that uses an inserting tool, and all the others reach `insertPreset` through `editPreset`, `shapeToolsOfferedPreset` or `drawPreset`.

items.claim: LayeredCurveDemo's partition hit band covers the whole seam height and swallows both seam anchors
items.note: The hit test now covers only the drawn handle plus 4 px.

items.claim: EffectChartPreviewDemo never closes the preview bitmaps it makes each frame
DrapeLabDemo writes a wheel-scrubbed radius outside the slider's 10–600 range
GeomDemo shows `NaN%` for the split share when the curve has zero length
HistoryDemo uses `s.stack`, a class its stylesheet doesn't define
items.note: I dropped the class rather than inventing a style for it. The same commit adds `__tests__/cssModuleClasses.test.ts`, which checks that every demo's CSS module defines each class the demo reads; HistoryDemo was the only one that failed it.
